map.NACA 2412 某攻角升力系数: Lift coefficient of NACA 2412 at a given angle of attack
: NACA 2412 has zero-lift angle of attack α0 ≈ −2° and lift curve slope about 0.1/° (≈5.7 /rad). At α = 4°, Cl ≈ 0.1 × (4 − (−2)) = 0.6; near the stall angle (about 16°) Cl reaches Clmax ≈ 1.5 then drops sharply.
map.由动压、升力系数与面积求升力: Lift from dynamic pressure, lift coefficient and area
map.升力系数会一直随攻角增大吗？: Does the lift coefficient keep rising with angle of attack?
map.不会。线性段过后（约 10–16° 依翼型而定）气流分离，Cl 在 Clmax: No. Past the linear range (about 10-16° depending on the airfoil) the flow separates, and Cl peaks at Clmax then drops sharply - stall. In flight the angle of attack must stay below the stall angle.
map.失速攻角和 Clmax 是固定的吗？: Are stall angle of attack and Clmax fixed?
map.随雷诺数、翼面污染（冰/虫）、后缘襟翼偏转变化。结冰会大幅降低 Clmax 并提: It varies with Reynolds number, surface contamination (ice / insects) and trailing edge flap deflection. Icing greatly lowers Clmax and triggers stall earlier, so speed is strictly limited in icing conditions. This tool computes from the given airfoil parameters.
